excerpt_i18n.en: Google suspended its Google Earth artificial intelligence (AI) image generation feature less than 48 hours after launch to strengthen security safeguards. Los expertos ya habían advertido de que esta herramienta, al superponer escenas ficticias sobre imágenes satelitales reales, podría utilizarse fácilmente para difundir información falsa. (The Paper)

items.title: 从翻译到桌面Agent，网易有道全线产品完成DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版升级
items.raw_excerpt: 日前，网易有道宣布旗下AI Agent产品矩阵已完成DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版的全面接入，覆盖全场景办公助手 Agent LobsterAI、有道词典、有道翻译、有道AI同传、Hi Echo、有道AI答疑笔、企业级大模型聚合平台ThinkFlow等系列产品和服务。这是继今年5月有道接入DeepSeek-V4预览版后，产品能力的又一次重要升级。 7月31日，DeepSeek正式开放V4-Flash正式版API公测。值得注意的是，DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 与预览版模型结构、参数规模完全一致，底层基座未做改动，仅完成新一轮后训练优化——底座没有变，变的是“后天教育”。正是通过更精细的后训练策略调优，Flash正式版的Agent能力实现了质的飞跃。 接入V4-Flash正式版后，有道旗下各产品的AI能力迎来全面升级。作为国内大厂首个100%开源桌面级办公助手Agent，LobsterAI在此次升级中同样迎来关键变化。V4-Flash正式版的接入，为LobsterAI带来了更经济的运行方式。新模型在后训练中专项优化的工具调用和多步骤任务执行能力，使其在同等任务复杂度下能够以更少的Token消耗完成相同工作，这意味着用户可以用更低的价格享受到更高效的Agent服务。 此外，LobsterAI已面向用户开放了岗位「专家套件」、Sites一键建站、多语言语音输入三大核心功能，将专业能力、内容交付、交互效率全面打通，让 AI 深度嵌入真实工作流程，成为 7×24 小时高效随行的岗位级助手。目前，LobsterAI已在GitHub上获得超5.7k Stars，日均交互数十万次。 图：LobsterAI 接入DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版丨LobsterAI 产品页截图 基于新模型的超长上下文能力，有道词典和有道翻译在处理长篇文档、学术论文等复杂翻译任

El 31 de julio, DeepSeek abrió oficialmente la prueba pública de API de la versión oficial de V4-Flash. Cabe destacar
excerpt_i18n.en: NetEase Youdao recently announced that its AI Agent product matrix has fully integrated the official DeepSeek-V4-Flash version, covering a range of products and services including the full-scenario office assistant Agent LobsterAI, Youdao Dictionary, Youdao Translate, Youdao AI Simultaneous Interpretation, Hi Echo, Youdao AI Q&A Pen, and the enterprise-level large model aggregation platform ThinkFlow. This marks another significant upgrade to product capabilities following Youdao's integration of the DeepSeek-V4 preview version in May this year. On July 31, DeepSeek officially opened public beta access to the V4-Flash official version API. Notably, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 has an identical model architecture and parameter scale to the preview version, with no changes to the underlying base model—only a new round of post-training optimization. The foundation remains unchanged; what changed is the "post-natal education." It is precisely through more refined post-training strategy tuning that the Flash official version's Agent capabilities have achieved a qualitative leap. After integrating the V4-Flash official version, the AI capabilities of Youdao's various products have been comprehensively upgraded. As the first 100% open-source desktop office assistant Agent from a major domestic tech company, LobsterAI has also undergone key changes in this upgrade. The integration of the V4-Flash official version has brought LobsterAI a more cost-effective way of operation.
